company.name: Bits to Atoms
company.shortDescription: Bits to Atoms focuses on computational design and additive manufacturing research and strategy.
company.description: Bits to Atoms focuses on computational design, additive manufacturing, and digital fabrication. The company researches software tools for design, simulation, and optimization in 3D printing and related processes. It engages in projects that explore the intersection of technology, architecture, and manufacturing. Bits to Atoms also provides educational content and documentation to support the adoption of digital fabrication methods.
